Risk: Compromise of an external reviewer credential exposing applicant PII and unpublished merit scores
Controls_In_Place: Multifactor authentication enforced for all 65 reviewer accounts since 24 July 2026; accounts expire at panel end plus 14 days; session timeout 30 minutes

Risk: Exploitation of an application input handling weakness to read or alter grant records
Threat_Source: External attacker, any member of the public able to start an application
Controls_In_Place: Allow list input validation on all 31 fields; context aware output encoding; parameterised queries; monthly authenticated web application scanning; annual penetration test

Risk: Exploitation of an unremediated software vulnerability in a system component or dependency
Threat_Source: External attacker; automated exploitation of a published vulnerability
Controls_In_Place: Weekly authenticated scanning; per build container scanning; service levels of 30 days for Critical and High; monthly patch cycle with an emergency path

Risk: Misuse of privileged access by an authorised administrator
Affected_Asset: Application, database and cloud control plane
Controls_In_Place: 16 privileged accounts across 3 groups; documented approval required; role assumed per task with logged justification; quarterly full population review; session recording on all brokered access

Risk: Undetected alteration of an award or disbursement record misdirecting federal funds
Controls_In_Place: Daily two way reconciliation against the payment service confirmation and the obligation balance; segregation of duties between award approval and disbursement; immutable audit trail

Risk: Compromise of a third party component introduced through the software supply chain
Threat_Source: Upstream compromise of a dependency or base image
Affected_Asset: Build pipeline, container images, application dependencies
Controls_In_Place: Signed base images; checksum verification in the pipeline; dependency scanning. Supply chain procedure drafted but not approved, and the scanner resolved direct dependencies only until August 2026

Risk: Extended service unavailability with an unverified recovery capability
Threat_Source: Infrastructure failure; regional outage; destructive incident
Controls_In_Place: Nightly backup with 35 day retention; cross region snapshot replication; multi availability zone deployment; continuity plan documented. The functional restore test has never been performed

Risk: Cloud misconfiguration exposing a data store to unauthorised access
Controls_In_Place: Infrastructure defined as code with peer review; continuous compliance rules evaluating every resource; public access blocked at the account level; data subnet has no internet route

Risk: Compromise of an agency user account through phishing
Controls_In_Place: PIV card authentication for all 420 agency accounts, which defeats credential replay; annual training with monthly tracking; email filtering; reporting path to the security operations centre

Risk: Mishandling of personal information in breach of the Privacy Act
Threat_Source: Process failure; excessive collection or retention
Controls_In_Place: Privacy impact assessment; collection limited to what the grant process requires; retention schedule enforced; access restricted by role; privacy officer review of any new data element

Risk: Insufficient audit evidence to support an investigation after an incident
Threat_Source: Control performed without leaving a record; retention misconfiguration
Affected_Asset: Audit records across seven log groups
Controls_In_Place: Seven log groups with one year online and two years archived; retention corrected March 2026; daily triage evidenced. The weekly correlated review record is still being automated

Risk: Weak key governance over the secondary region copy of system data
Threat_Source: Loss of agency control over key policy and key usage visibility
Affected_Asset: Replicated snapshots in the secondary region
Controls_In_Place: All data encrypted at rest. Primary region uses a customer managed key with agency controlled policy, rotation and usage logging. Secondary region key created 30 July 2026, re-encryption of existing snapshots pending
